name: Tomato Early Blight (टमाटर का अगेती झुलसा)
symptoms: Concentric rings ('bulls-eye' pattern) on older lower leaves, dark brown spots with yellow halos, premature defoliation.
favorableConditions: Warm temperatures (24-29°C) combined with high humidity, heavy morning dew, or frequent sprinkler irrigation.
organicRemedy: Spray Neem Oil (5ml/L) or Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide (5g/L). Remove and bury infected bottom leaves immediately.
chemicalRemedy: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil @ 2g/L. In advanced stages, spray Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1ml/L.
prevention: Maintain adequate plant spacing for airflow, practice drip irrigation instead of overhead watering, rotate crops with non-solanaceous plants.

name: Tomato Late Blight (टमाटर का पछेती झुलसा)
symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips and margins, white fuzzy fungal growth on leaf undersides during cool damp mornings, rapid stem rot.
favorableConditions: Cool, overcast weather (15-20°C) with relative humidity exceeding 90% for consecutive days.
organicRemedy: Bordeaux Mixture (1%) or Copper Hydroxide spray. Destroy heavily infected plants to stop airborne spore spread.
chemicalRemedy: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil MZ) @ 2.5g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2g/L.
prevention: Monitor local weather alerts for sudden temperature drops and rain, avoid planting near potato fields, use certified disease-free transplants.

name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus / CLCuV (कपास का पत्ती मरोड़ रोग)
symptoms: Upward or downward curling of leaf margins, thickening of veins, leaf-like outgrowths (enations) under leaves, severe plant stunting.
favorableConditions: High population of whiteflies in hot and humid pre-monsoon weather.
organicRemedy: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 per acre) to trap vector whiteflies. Spray Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) or Verticillium lecanii.
chemicalRemedy: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2g/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L or Afidopyropen 50g/L @ 2ml/L to control the vector.
prevention: Plant CLCuD-resistant Bt hybrids, eliminate weed hosts like Parthenium and Abutilon along field bunds.

name: Rice / Paddy Blast (धान का झोंका रोग)
symptoms: Spindle-shaped or diamond-shaped lesions on leaves with grey/white centers and brownish borders. Neck blast causes panicles to turn greyish and break.
favorableConditions: High nitrogen application, cloudy weather, high relative humidity (>90%), and night temperatures between 19-23°C.
organicRemedy: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed. Foliar spray of Cow urine (10%) mixed with Hing (asafoetida) extract.
chemicalRemedy: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5ml/L or Kasugamycin @ 2ml/L.
prevention: Avoid excessive split applications of Urea/Nitrogen; maintain balanced NPK with Potassium; ensure clean field drainage.

name: Wheat Yellow / Stripe Rust (गेहूं का पीला रतुआ)
symptoms: Linear rows (stripes) of bright yellow/orange powdery pustules along leaf veins. Powder rubs off readily on farmer's fingers or clothing.
favorableConditions: Cool temperatures (10-15°C) with persistent fog or light rain in Northern and North-Western plains during Jan-Feb.
organicRemedy: Early morning dusting of fine sulfur powder or bio-agent Bacillus subtilis spray. Rogue out initial infected focus patches immediately.
chemicalRemedy: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L as soon as first pustules are spotted.
prevention: Sow rust-resistant wheat varieties (e.g., HD-2967, HD-3086, DBW-187, DBW-222). Avoid late sowing.

name: Soybean Yellow Mosaic Virus (सोयाबीन पीला मोज़ेक)
symptoms: Irregular bright yellow and green patches on leaves, leaf crinkling, reduced pod size and unfilled seeds.
favorableConditions: Hot dry spells following intermittent rains accelerating whitefly vector multiplication.
organicRemedy: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) along with 0.1% liquid soap. Roguing of infected plants in the first 25 days.
chemicalRemedy: Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.5g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.4g/L to manage vector whiteflies.
prevention: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 48% FS @ 1.25ml/kg seed; maintain clean bunds free of weed reservoirs.

name: Potato Early Blight (आलू का अगेती झुलसा)
symptoms: Brown circular spots with distinct concentric rings on leaves, target-board effect, premature leaf drop.
favorableConditions: Alternating dry and humid spells with temperatures around 25°C.
organicRemedy: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum (5g/L) or fermented buttermilk (5%) + Copper oxychloride.
prevention: Use certified seed tubers; ensure proper crop rotation; apply balanced potash fertilizers.

name: Healthy Crop Foliage (स्वस्थ फसल)
symptoms: Uniform green leaf pigmentation, strong vascular turgor, clean margins, no lesions, necrosis, or pest feeding damage.
favorableConditions: Optimal soil moisture, balanced nutrition, active photosynthesis, and favorable weather.
organicRemedy: Continue standard preventive biological maintenance (e.g., Jeevamrut / Panchagavya foliar tonic once every 15 days).
chemicalRemedy: No chemical application required. Avoid unnecessary pesticide sprays to protect beneficial pollinators and predatory insects.
prevention: Maintain regular scouting every 3-4 days, ensure timely scheduled irrigation and balanced micronutrient fertilization.
